headline: Beef 🐄💰 SKYROCKETS 🚀📈 but NOBODY's CASHING IN 💸😭
text:
US beef 🥩 prices HITTING RECORD HIGHS 📊💥 but cattle ranchers like Eric Gropper 🤠🐎 aren't popping corks 🍾😩! Prices JUMPED 12% 🚀📈 - triple inflation rate 🧮💨 - but his 350 breeding cows 🐮💕 on 8,000 acres 🏞️🌾 in South Dakota ain't making bank 🏦💰! Drought 🌵☀️ dried up his 13 natural wells 💧🚫 so he's hauling water 🛢️🚛 like a desert nomad 🐪🏜️! Fewer cows nationwide than since 1951 📉😱 cuz drought + disease 🦠💀 got the herd THINNER than a runway model 👠📏!

Gropper's selling 600lb calves 🐂💪 for $2,500 💵🔥 - up from $2,000 two years ago 📈🤑 - but his costs EXPLODED 💥💸! Pickup trucks 🚛💨 went from $40k to $100k 🤑😭, fence posts 🪵📏 tripled to $19, barbed wire 🧵🛡️ doubled to $130! Hay for hungry cows 🐄🌾 costs an ARM and a LEG 🦴💸! "I'm paying bills but input costs are SO HIGH 📈😩 that without record prices we'd all be BROKE 💸🚫!"

Calves go to feedlots 🏭🐄 where 95% of US cattle get CORN-FED 🍿🐮 before slaughter 🔪🥩! Brenda Boetel 👩‍🏫📊 says feedlot companies selling at record highs but buying at all-time peaks too 🔄💸 - no profit party 🎉🚫!

Four meatpacking giants Tyson 🏢🥩, JBS, Cargill, National Beef control 85% of processing 🏭🔒! Even Trump 🍊👑 called them out for price-fixing 🎯💰 but they're LOSING MONEY 📉😭! Tyson dropped $500M 💸💥 on beef this year cuz they're paying record prices for cattle too 🔄📉!

Small packer Jamie Crumley 👩‍💼🥩 at Harpley's says live animal costs UP 60% 📈😤 but can't pass it all to supermarkets 🛒💸 cuz customers will SWITCH to chicken 🍗 or imported beef 🌍🥩! Her plant runs at 350 cows instead of 450 capacity 🏭📉 so fixed costs spread THIN like cheap margarine 🧈💸 - losing $100-$400 per head 💸😭!

Restaurants like Block 16 🍔🏪 in Omaha can't charge $13 for burgers 🍔💰 cuz customers will BOUNCE 🚪💨! Paul Urban says they'd need that price to profit but "I wouldn't pay $13 for a cheeseburger either 🧀🍔😤 so we take the hit 💸😩!"

It's a money-go-round 🔄💰 where everyone TURNS OVER more cash 🤑📊 but KEEPS none of it 🏦🚫! More cows take THREE YEARS to arrive 🐄⏰ - heifers need 2 years to breed, calves need another year to fatten 🐂📅! Can't conjure cows overnight 🪄🐮🚫 so prices stay HIGH while everyone stays BROKE 💸😭!
